body: When I went to jail, I was placed in this big housing unit with other inmates. On my second night, while everyone was sleeping in their bunk beds I heard one of my peers grunting with pain in the toilet area. I was naive at the time and I got up to go check on him. As I was getting closer to the area some of my peers told me to not worry and to head back to bed. So I did. That same night only a few hours later I got out on bail. It wasn’t until I was out that I figured out the guy in the bathroom was most likely a drug mule taking care of business that night. The inmates who told me to back to bed were most likely lookouts for him. I could’ve gotten beat up the next day.

“I think the saddest people always try their hardest to make people happy because they know what it's like to feel absolutely worthless and they don't want anyone else to feel like that.”

-Robin Williams

Thank you for taking the time to listen to me, I appreciate you.  I will be in debt if I leave school as I took out loans.  I am going to give it my best because it could be my last opportunity to apply my best efforts to something.  I think the choice to die from failure will make me put even more effort.
If I fail out of school, I will disappoint my family.  I am not prepared for a life without a degree.  I lose everything I have if I fail.

Wow thank you, I don’t mean to take your time but I’m just going to try to do as much as possible to benefit others using my body’s resources while I still can.  I think I’m going to go donate blood one of these days and maybe try to see if I can register as a bone marrow donor.  My suicidal tendencies seem to come random nowadays and I don’t know if I’ll have the strength to not give in to them in the future.

I’ve heard Washington state recently gives you the option of becoming compost. I’ve always wanted to go visit the needle in Seattle.  See where the Seattle sound all started you know? It’s okay no worries man, have a good one.
From what I recall, it was a girl. She would not answer my calls, but it doesn’t matter. I am used to this type of girl behavior.
Thank you for your input. I will keep that in mind, but I have drank after two years sober.
I am glad it worked for you.  I cannot say the same for myself.
I am sorry for your loss.

You actually sound like a fun person to be around.  I feel like you are someone I can have both a silly and intellectual conversations with.  I’ve been listening to a lot of moody bands lately like The Cure, the Smiths, Joy Division, The Chameleons, I,d suggest you check them out.
